notes.title: Added back Font and Background Color Editing
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone, with the past new update, I noticed the font color and background color editing feature was missing, 
[/b]
I have now added it back in the form of a hex codes, allowing more more control over the colors presented.[i] I will work to include a color picker option back as well, but will also look into possibly adding gradient and font stroke features. 
[/i]
[i][b]Thanks everyone who has continued to provide feedback and support![/b][/i]

notes.title: New Settings UI and Fonts
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we've improved the overall look and feel of the settings menu! Also, we've introduced a new setting of fonts. Now you'll be able to theme your counters to the theme of the game you're playing. 

We'll be adding more fonts in the future alongside some more features, thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Stream Counter Update
notes.content:
The feedback for the counter has been great and I have been working on some new features. Here are the first new features that have been added to the utility:

[list]
[*] Font Color is now editable!
[*] Background Color is now editable!
[*] Other minor changes.
[/list]

[b]Thank you everyone for providing me with suggestions ːsteamthumbsupː more updates to come![/b]
